name: Admin dashboard routes to full-page AI Agent
description: Verifies the dashboard opens the dedicated agent workspace and retains the glass mobile layout.
steps: Check country, purpose and applicant context controls
expected: A full-page chat workspace opens with selectable country and purpose.

name: Upload and preview a PDF file
description: Verifies file selection creates a browser-session entry that can be previewed.
expected: The PDF preview modal shows the file and zoom controls.

name: Create country-specific applicant profile
description: Verifies country and visa purpose selections appear in the generated draft profile.
expected: A draft profile shows the selected destination, purpose and checklist.

name: Generate printable A4 visa dossier
description: Verifies the checklist preview reflects form inputs and the print/save action is available.
expected: The preview updates from the form and the browser print dialog is requested.

name: Deployment scan validates repository input
description: Verifies repository input validation and honest reporting about unconnected live integrations.
expected: Missing input prompts for a repository; valid format reports validation and provider configuration status without claiming a live push.
